items.title: Stokes Named Davey O’Brien National Quarterback of the Week
items.summary: FORT WORTH, Texas – University of Memphis quarterback Marcus Stokes picked up another accolade, being named the Davey O'Brien National Quarterback of the Week after accounting for five touchdowns in Memphis' 49-22 win over Army.

items.title: Memphis Upsets Iowa State in Season Opener
items.summary: The Memphis Tigers took down the No.18 Iowa State Cyclones 80-76 in their season opener. While the Cyclones were the betting favorite, the Tigers, led by Jayden Reid, looked like the superior team through and through.

items.title: Marcus Stokes responds to Tulane disaster with consecutive strong performances
items.summary: Looking at the two games following Tulane, it seems like Stokes' message about each player doing their individual job worked. Memphis beat East Carolina 41-34 in overtime and Army 49-22 in dominating fashion. During those two games, the offense was clicking with the Tigers taking what the defenses were giving them.

items.title: Tiger Offense Dominates in 49-22 Win Over Army
items.summary: MEMPHIS, Tenn. – The University of Memphis (7-2, 4-1 American) football team stormed out to a strong first-half lead, scoring in every quarter and recording at least 100 yards of offense in all four quarters of a 49-22 win over Army (5-3, 4-2 American) Saturday night inside Simmons Bank Liberty Stadium.
